faqs.q: What is the LTV formula used here?
faqs.a: LTV = Average Order Value × Purchases per Year × Customer Lifespan (years). Annual value = AOV × Frequency.

faqs.q: Is this customer LTV calculator free and AI-free?
faqs.a: Yes. It is free on Zetawala and uses only deterministic math—no machine learning or invented benchmarks.

faqs.q: How do I use LTV with CAC?
faqs.a: A healthy rule of thumb is LTV several times higher than CAC. Pair this tool with the Customer CAC Calculator to see whether acquisition spend is sustainable.

faqs.q: Does LTV include profit margin or only revenue?
faqs.a: This calculator projects revenue LTV from order value and repeat purchases. For contribution margins, combine with profit-margin or unit-economics tools.

faqs.q: Who benefits from calculating customer LTV?
faqs.a: Ecommerce brands, subscription businesses, agencies, and growth marketers deciding how much they can spend to acquire a customer.

faqs.q: What if purchase frequency is irregular?
faqs.a: Use a realistic average over a year. You can model optimistic and conservative frequency scenarios—results update instantly for each.
